name: Loops
desc: Loops is an email platform for sending beautiful transactional and marketing emails. Manage contacts, trigger automations with events, and send transactional emails from your workflows.

actions.name: create_contact
actions.description: Creates a new contact in Loops. Returns an error if a contact with the given email already exists.

actions.name: send_event
actions.description: Sends an event to Loops for a contact. Events can trigger email automations configured in your Loops dashboard.

actions.name: send_transactional_email
actions.description: Sends a transactional email to a contact using a pre-built template in Loops.

actions.name: find_contact
actions.description: Finds a contact in Loops by their email address or user ID.

actions.name: delete_contact
actions.description: Permanently deletes a contact from Loops by their email address or user ID.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
